name: Thomas Tucker
source:
LIKES: Jazz
DISLIKES: Bad coffee 

Thomas is the co-owner and head chef of Cafe Merryment.

A lover of good food and jazz music, he's a close friend and trusted mentor, who has consistently supported and encouraged Myka over the time they have known each other.
